text: Hello, I'm not sure if I'm overreacting. My stepson is 10 and his temp is 39.5, I think that's quite high for him? He's got a runny blocked nose and keeps sneezing, so maybe it's just a bad cold. I did check his neck because I panicked and it seems fine, he can look right down at his toes no problem. I'm honestly a bit scared, his dad's away and I don't know what's normal for him
